q: How is chakki atta different from regular atta?
a: We grind whole wheat on slow millstones that stay cool, so bran and germ stay in the flour. Most packaged atta is roller-milled at high speed; germ is often removed for longer warehouse life. You will notice a nuttier aroma, a slightly coarser feel, and dough that drinks a little more water.

q: How long does the flour stay fresh?
a: Because the wheat germ oils are intact, use atta within 45–60 days of the grinding date on the pack. Store in an airtight tin, away from heat. Millet flours (bajra especially) are happiest within six weeks.

q: Do you add maida, preservatives, or bleach?
a: No. Every product is a single flour or a declared grain blend. Nothing is bleached, bromated, or preserved. Our FSSAI licence number is printed on every pack and on this website.
